episodes.title: Inflation biting hard ahead of Christmas

stories.angle: Struggling households facing a challenging Christmas period due to soaring inflation and economic pressures.
stories.voices: Isabella Higgins, host (live); Margaret, self-funded retiree (pre-recorded); Simon Peng, retailer (pre-recorded); Paul Bloxham, Chief Economist Australia, HSBC (clip)
stories.tone: Alarmed and sympathetic towards households facing cost-of-living stress, mixed with objective economic analysis.
stories.emphasis: Human impact of inflation, cost of basic goods, and broader economic headwinds.
stories.placement: Lead item, occupying the entirety of the broadcast segment.
stories.evidence: Many Australians could be facing a challenging Christmas period ahead as new fears of stagflation grip the nation.

episodes.title: Economists react to inflation hitting 4.9 per cent

stories.angle: Soaring inflation figures putting pressure on the Reserve Bank and households, requiring productivity boosts.
stories.voices: Patricia Karvelas, host (live); Andrew McKellar, Chief Executive, Australian Chamber of Commerce and Industry (live); Bessa Deda, Chief Economist, Westpac (live)
stories.tone: Inquisitive and urgent, pressing economic experts on what solutions exist to fix supply constraints and tame inflation.
stories.emphasis: Macroeconomic data, interest rates, supply and demand imbalances, and productivity.
stories.evidence: There's still significant inflation pressure in the economy, and I think it should ring alarm bells.

stories.angle: Housing costs and construction issues as major contributors to inflationary pressures.
stories.voices: Patricia Karvelas, host (live); Tom Devitt, Senior Economist, Housing Industry Association (clip); Bessa Deda, Chief Economist, Westpac (live)
stories.emphasis: Construction costs, supply chain bottlenecks, and the need for housing investment.
stories.evidence: Housing industry association's senior economist Tom Devitt says a lot of that comes from high construction costs.

stories.story: Liberal Senator Leah Blyth defects to One Nation
stories.angle: Political defection creating fresh friction within the opposition and raising questions about political loyalty.
stories.voices: Patricia Karvelas, host (live); Lexi J一般的な, political reporter (live); Pauline Hanson, Leader, One Nation (clip); Simon Birmingham, Shadow Minister (clip)
stories.tone: Analytical and political reporting, exploring the motivations behind the defection.
stories.emphasis: Political strategy, party dynamics, and coalition stability.
stories.evidence: South Australian Liberal Senator Leah Blyth has defected to Pauline Hanson's One Nation in a fresh blow to the opposition.

episodes.title: David Shoebridge on Greens parliamentary negotiations

stories.angle: The Greens playing a crucial role in passing various bills in the Senate while maintaining pressure on the government.
stories.voices: Patricia Karvelas, host (live); David Shoebridge, Greens Senator (live); Leah Blyth, Senator (clip)
stories.tone: Direct and probing political interview, with the host challenging the guest on party positioning.
stories.emphasis: Legislative process, political leverage, and policy priorities.
stories.evidence: The Greens have played a crucial part in the passage of various bills this week in the Senate.

stories.story: Cost of living pressures and business impact
stories.angle: Small businesses and holidaymakers feeling the severe pinch of cost-of-living pressures.
stories.voices: Patricia Karvelas, host (live); Jeremy Story Carter, reporter (pre-recorded); Samantha Rickerson, caravan park owner (pre-recorded)
stories.tone: Sympathetic to struggling business owners and consumers facing cost-of-living constraints.
stories.emphasis: Regional economic impacts, tourism, and small business struggles.
stories.evidence: Her family-owned business is feeling the impact of cost-of-living pressures on holidaymakers.

stories.story: Economic pessimism and trust in politicians
stories.angle: Public pessimism rising as trust in politicians sags to new lows amid economic uncertainty.
stories.voices: Patricia Karvelas, host (live); Jeremy Story Carter, reporter (pre-recorded)
stories.tone: Reflective and concerned about falling public trust in democratic institutions.
stories.emphasis: Social cohesion, polling data, and political disenchantment.
stories.evidence: Australians are becoming more pessimistic and our trust in politicians is sagging to new lows.

stories.story: Defence security pact with Solomon Islands
stories.angle: Government praising a new security pack signed with Solomon Islands while addressing regional stability.
stories.voices: Patricia Karvelas, host (live); Pat Conroy, Minister for Defence Industry and International Development (live); Anthony Albanese, Prime Minister (clip); Oliver Nobetau, Pacific Islands program director, Lowy Institute (live)
stories.tone: Formal and diplomatic, focusing on strategic partnerships in the Pacific.
stories.emphasis: Geopolitics, regional security, and bilateral agreements.
stories.evidence: The federal government has come under more pressure from the opposition to do more on the cost of living.

stories.angle: Political fallout from Senator Leah Blyth's defection to One Nation.
stories.voices: Patricia Karvelas, host (live); Matt Canavan, Nationals Senator (live); Leah Blyth, Senator (clip)
stories.tone: Investigative and critical of political defections.
stories.emphasis: Political ramifications, party stability, and shifting allegiances.
stories.evidence: South Australian Liberal Senator Leah Blyth has defected to Pauline Hanson's One Nation.

episodes.title: China welcomes first foreign national to Tiangong space station

stories.story: China's Tiangong space station welcomes foreign national
stories.angle: China's ambitious space program marking a milestone by welcoming its first foreign national aboard the space station.
stories.voices: Patricia Karvelas, host (live); Muhammad Zishan Ali, Pakistani astronaut (clip); Marco Alberti, Associate Director of International Engagement and Education, European Space Policy Institute (live)
stories.emphasis: Space exploration, international cooperation, and geopolitical milestones.
stories.evidence: China has successfully launched a new space mission this time with a Pakistani astronaut along for the ride.

episodes.title: US spy agencies suffer cybersecurity breach

stories.angle: A reported cybersecurity breach at the CIA raising questions about intelligence agency vulnerabilities.
stories.voices: Patricia Karvelas, host (live); Nick Leeson, President, Center for Advancing Cybersecurity (pre-recorded)
stories.tone: Serious and technical reporting on national security matters.
stories.emphasis: Cybersecurity, intelligence vulnerabilities, and national security.
stories.evidence: There's been a reported cyber security breach at the CIA just weeks after a series of highly disruptive system failures.
